experiment_data.hypothesis: Random k=1 RSFT baseline: same candidate pool as CED RSFT but random selection instead of CED scoring. If random RSFT significantly underperforms CED RSFT (rel_f1 gap > 1.5pp), proves CED scoring precision is the key, not just data filtering quantity. CED k=1 mean rel_f1=0.4596, expect random < 0.445.
